source_findings: Assistant-authored. Both mapper components selected EIA span s_6af27ac482a98ade (1417:1503), which establishes that earlier automated meters could periodically report electricity use to the utility. Raw and stored claim 1 gives the requested data, cadence and recipient, but renders a historical capability as a present-tense statement.

Raw and stored claim 2 draws on s_2845cfa10cf8e534 (1055:1211), which supports general utility metering. It adds no information about what the earlier automated meters reported or who received those reports. Both mapper components selected this generic span, and the composer retained it. The frozen protocol requires every claim to be relevant to the requested evidence.

The previous wireless-reporting scope error did not recur. Both claims have explicit subjects, no fallback or editorial correction occurred, and NeMo passed. The development source/completeness gate fails on relevance and historical wording. Owner adjudication is pending.
